title: Describe routines and preferences
lessons:
# Chapter 4 — Describe routines and preferences

## Goals and prerequisites
Combine the identity, question, and repair language from Chapters 1–3 to describe a normal day, say what you like, and explain a simple preference. You do not need an extensive vocabulary list: learn a verb with a useful time phrase and one real example. If present-tense endings are unfamiliar, concentrate on the subject + verb chunks in this chapter.

## Present tense patterns
For regular **-er** verbs such as `parler` (speak), remove **-er** and add **-e, -es, -e, -ons, -ez, -ent**: je parle, tu parles, il parle, nous parlons, vous parlez, ils parlent. The **-e, -es, -ent** endings usually sound alike or are silent, so listen for the subject and context. **-ir** verbs like `finir` use **-is, -is, -it, -issons, -issez, -issent**: nous finissons. **-re** verbs like `attendre` use **-s, -s, no ending, -ons, -ez, -ent**: j'attends, vous attendez. These are productive patterns, but many frequent verbs are irregular; learn those as chunks rather than forcing a rule.

Common irregulars include `faire` (do/make: je fais, vous faites, ils font), `aller` (go: je vais, vous allez, ils vont), and `prendre` (take: je prends, vous prenez, ils prennent). `Aimer`, `préférer`, and `détester` express likes. To say you enjoy an activity, use **aimer + infinitive**: `J'aime marcher` (I like walking). With a noun, use an article: `J'aime le café`. For a preference between options, say `Je préfère le thé au café` (I prefer tea to coffee). French often uses `beaucoup` after the verb: `J'aime beaucoup lire` (I really like reading).

## Routine chunks and time
Useful frequency phrases include `tous les jours` (every day), `souvent` (often), `parfois` (sometimes), `rarement` (rarely), and `d'habitude` (usually). Put them near the verb: `Je prends souvent le bus`. A routine can be sequenced with `d'abord` (first), `puis` (then), `ensuite` (next), and `le soir` (in the evening). A typical description has a time anchor, an action, and a small detail: `Le matin, je prépare un café et je lis les nouvelles.`

Reflexive daily verbs include `se lever` (get up), `se préparer` (get ready), and `se coucher` (go to bed). They take a matching pronoun: je me lève, tu te lèves, elle se lève, nous nous levons, vous vous levez, ils se lèvent. In a negative, the ne...pas surrounds the pronoun plus verb: `Je ne me couche pas tard`. Use only routine verbs needed to talk about your own day.

## Use all four skills
Listen for the order of actions and frequency words; do not confuse a one-time schedule with a usual routine. Read a short personal post and distinguish facts from opinions. Speak for 30 seconds with a beginning, two routine actions, one preference, and a closing. Write a short paragraph with connectors rather than a disconnected list. Ask a follow-up question to keep a conversation going.

## Cumulative retrieval
Retrieve before opening; then adapt one example to your real routine.

Before the first reveal: From memory, say in French that you often take the bus; then give the nous and vous forms of parler.

:::answer
`Je prends souvent le bus` = I often take the bus. For regular -er verbs, **nous** takes **-ons** (`nous parlons`) and **vous** takes **-ez** (`vous parlez`).
:::

Before the second reveal: Say in French that you like walking, prefer tea to coffee, and get up; use a reflexive pronoun for the last action.

:::answer
`J'aime marcher` means I like walking. For a preference: `Je préfère le thé au café.` `Je me lève` = I get up; reflexive verbs include a subject-matching pronoun.
:::

## Self-check and spacing
Can you describe three routine actions in order? Can you place souvent or parfois near the verb? Can you say one thing you like and ask someone else about a preference? Mark any irregular form you guessed. Review 15 items tomorrow, three days later, and one week later. On each pass, retell the routine with a different time phrase and one changed detail; retrieve from memory before listening to the model audio.

bank.fr: Je me lève à six heures.
bank.en: I get up at six o'clock.
bank.cue: The reflexive verb is se lever.

bank.fr: Elle se prépare en silence.
bank.en: She gets ready quietly.

bank.fr: Nous prenons le petit-déjeuner ensemble.
bank.en: We have breakfast together.

bank.fr: Je bois un thé avant de partir.
bank.en: I drink tea before leaving.

bank.fr: Tu pars tôt le lundi.
bank.en: You leave early on Mondays.
bank.prompt: Ask a friend whether they leave early on Mondays.

bank.fr: Mon train arrive à huit heures.
bank.en: My train arrives at eight o'clock.

bank.fr: Je marche jusqu'au bureau.
bank.en: I walk to the office.
bank.cue: Jusqu'au means as far as/to the.

bank.fr: Elle prend le métro tous les jours.
bank.en: She takes the subway every day.
bank.cue: Tous les jours means every day.

bank.fr: Nous commençons le travail à neuf heures.
bank.en: We start work at nine.

bank.fr: Vous finissez à quelle heure ?
bank.en: What time do you finish?
bank.prompt: Ask a colleague about finishing time.
bank.cue: Finir uses the -issez form with vous.

bank.fr: Je réponds aux courriels le matin.
bank.en: I answer emails in the morning.
bank.prompt: Hear when the emails are answered.
bank.cue: Le matin gives the time of day.

bank.fr: Il attend le premier client.
bank.en: He waits for the first customer.
bank.prompt: Identify whom he is waiting for.

bank.fr: Ma collègue prépare le rapport.
bank.en: My colleague prepares the report.

bank.fr: Je fais une pause vers midi.
bank.en: I take a break around noon.
bank.cue: Faire une pause is a fixed chunk.

bank.fr: On déjeune avec l'équipe.
bank.en: We have lunch with the team.

bank.fr: Ils discutent pendant la pause.
bank.en: They chat during the break.

bank.fr: Je préfère travailler le matin.
bank.en: I prefer working in the morning.
bank.cue: Préférer is followed by an infinitive.

bank.fr: Elle aime écouter des balados.
bank.en: She likes listening to podcasts.
bank.cue: Aimer + infinitive expresses liking an activity.

bank.fr: Nous adorons cuisiner à la maison.
bank.en: We love cooking at home.
bank.prompt: Say an activity your household loves.

bank.fr: Mon frère déteste faire la vaisselle.
bank.en: My brother hates doing the dishes.
bank.cue: Faire la vaisselle is wash dishes.

bank.fr: Tu préfères le café ou le thé ?
bank.en: Do you prefer coffee or tea?
bank.prompt: Ask someone to choose a drink.

bank.fr: Je choisis le thé sans sucre.
bank.en: I choose tea without sugar.
bank.prompt: Understand the chosen drink and detail.

bank.fr: Elle lit avant de dormir.
bank.en: She reads before sleeping.

bank.fr: Je regarde rarement la télévision.
bank.en: I rarely watch television.
bank.prompt: Use rarely in a routine description.

bank.fr: Nous écoutons la radio en voiture.
bank.en: We listen to the radio in the car.
bank.prompt: Hear where the radio is played.
bank.cue: En voiture means in the car.

bank.fr: Il joue au soccer après le travail.
bank.en: He plays soccer after work.

bank.fr: Je fais du yoga deux fois par semaine.
bank.en: I do yoga twice a week.
bank.cue: Deux fois par semaine means twice a week.

bank.fr: Elle va à la piscine le samedi.
bank.en: She goes to the pool on Saturdays.

bank.fr: On se retrouve au parc le dimanche.
bank.en: We meet at the park on Sundays.

bank.fr: Mes amis arrivent souvent en avance.
bank.en: My friends often arrive early.
bank.cue: En avance means early/ahead of time.

bank.fr: Je rentre chez moi vers six heures.
bank.en: I get home around six.
bank.cue: Rentrer chez moi means go home.

bank.fr: Nous préparons le dîner à tour de rôle.
bank.en: We take turns preparing dinner.
bank.cue: À tour de rôle means in turn.

bank.fr: Mon fils met la table.
bank.en: My son sets the table.
bank.cue: Mettre la table is set the table.

bank.fr: Je range la cuisine après le repas.
bank.en: I tidy the kitchen after the meal.

bank.fr: Elle arrose les plantes le soir.
bank.en: She waters the plants in the evening.

bank.fr: Le chat dort sur le canapé.
bank.en: The cat sleeps on the sofa.

bank.fr: Je me couche avant minuit.
bank.en: I go to bed before midnight.
bank.prompt: Say when you go to bed.

bank.fr: Il se couche très tard le vendredi.
bank.en: He goes to bed very late on Fridays.

bank.fr: Nous nous reposons après le déjeuner.
bank.en: We rest after lunch.

bank.fr: Tu te réveilles avec une alarme ?
bank.en: Do you wake up with an alarm?
bank.prompt: Ask a friend about their alarm.

bank.fr: Je me réveille naturellement.
bank.en: I wake up naturally.

bank.fr: D'habitude, nous prenons le même chemin.
bank.en: Usually, we take the same route.

bank.fr: Parfois, je travaille à la bibliothèque.
bank.en: Sometimes I work at the library.

bank.fr: Elle fait ses courses le jeudi.
bank.en: She does her shopping on Thursdays.
bank.cue: Faire ses courses is grocery/shop errands.

bank.fr: Nous allons au marché chaque semaine.
bank.en: We go to the market every week.

bank.fr: Je préfère les marchés aux supermarchés.
bank.en: I prefer markets to supermarkets.
bank.cue: Préférer A à B: markets to supermarkets.

bank.fr: Mon quartier est calme le matin.
bank.en: My neighbourhood is quiet in the morning.
bank.prompt: Understand when the area is quiet.
bank.cue: Le matin is the time expression.

bank.fr: Les cafés ouvrent tôt ici.
bank.en: The cafés open early here.

bank.fr: La bibliothèque ferme à dix-huit heures.
bank.en: The library closes at 18:00.

bank.fr: Je lis le journal pendant le trajet.
bank.en: I read the newspaper during the commute.
bank.prompt: Describe what you do while travelling.

bank.fr: Il écoute de la musique en faisant le ménage.
bank.en: He listens to music while cleaning.

bank.fr: Je ne bois pas de café le soir.
bank.en: I don't drink coffee in the evening.
bank.source: Je bois du café le soir.
bank.prompt: Make this statement negative while keeping the time detail.

bank.fr: Elle ne regarde jamais son téléphone au dîner.
bank.en: She never looks at her phone at dinner.

bank.fr: Nous ne sortons presque jamais en semaine.
bank.en: We hardly ever go out during the week.
bank.prompt: Hear how often the group goes out.

bank.fr: Je prends parfois un jour de congé.
bank.en: I sometimes take a day off.
bank.cue: Jour de congé means day off.

bank.fr: Tu fais quoi après les cours ?
bank.en: What do you do after class?
bank.prompt: Ask a friend about after-class plans.

bank.fr: Après le cours, je retrouve une amie.
bank.en: After class, I meet a friend.
bank.cue: Retrouver une amie means meet a friend.

bank.fr: Nous parlons de nos projets.
bank.en: We talk about our plans.

bank.fr: Elle apprend une nouvelle recette chaque mois.
bank.en: She learns a new recipe every month.
bank.prompt: Hear the frequency of her learning.

bank.fr: Je cuisine rarement des plats compliqués.
bank.en: I rarely cook complicated dishes.

bank.fr: Mon partenaire prépare un excellent café.
bank.en: My partner makes excellent coffee.

bank.fr: Nous invitons nos voisins une fois par mois.
bank.en: We invite our neighbours once a month.
bank.cue: Une fois par mois means once a month.

bank.fr: Les enfants jouent dehors après l'école.
bank.en: The children play outside after school.

bank.fr: Il pleut souvent en automne.
bank.en: It often rains in autumn.
bank.cue: Il pleut is the weather expression.

bank.fr: Je prends un parapluie quand il pleut.
bank.en: I take an umbrella when it rains.
bank.prompt: Explain what you do in rainy weather.

bank.fr: Le samedi, nous faisons une longue promenade.
bank.en: On Saturdays, we take a long walk.
bank.cue: Faire une promenade means take a walk.

bank.fr: Je visite un musée de temps en temps.
bank.en: I visit a museum from time to time.
bank.cue: De temps en temps means from time to time.

bank.fr: Ma sœur préfère les expositions de photographie.
bank.en: My sister prefers photography exhibitions.
bank.prompt: Hear the type of exhibition she likes.

bank.fr: Nous partageons les tâches ménagères.
bank.en: We share the household chores.

bank.fr: Je nettoie la salle de bains le mercredi.
bank.en: I clean the bathroom on Wednesdays.
bank.cue: Nettoyer has a spelling change in some forms.

bank.fr: Il répare son vélo le week-end.
bank.en: He repairs his bicycle on weekends.

bank.fr: Elle jardine quand il fait beau.
bank.en: She gardens when the weather is nice.
bank.cue: Il fait beau means the weather is nice.

bank.fr: Je n'aime pas me dépêcher le matin.
bank.en: I don't like rushing in the morning.
bank.cue: Aimer is negated; reflexive infinitive follows.

bank.fr: Nous préférons prendre notre temps.
bank.en: We prefer to take our time.
bank.cue: Prendre son temps means take one's time.

bank.fr: Elle choisit ses vêtements la veille.
bank.en: She chooses her clothes the day before.
bank.cue: La veille means the day before.

bank.fr: Je prépare mon sac avant de me coucher.
bank.en: I pack my bag before going to bed.
bank.prompt: Hear when the bag is prepared.

bank.fr: Tu oublies parfois tes clés ?
bank.en: Do you sometimes forget your keys?

bank.fr: Je vérifie toujours la météo.
bank.en: I always check the weather.

bank.fr: On prend un café après la promenade.
bank.en: We have coffee after the walk.
bank.cue: Après introduces the event that follows.

bank.fr: Je téléphone à ma mère chaque dimanche.
bank.en: I call my mother every Sunday.
bank.cue: Téléphoner à takes à before the person.

bank.fr: Il envoie un message à ses parents.
bank.en: He sends a message to his parents.
bank.cue: À ses parents names the recipients.

bank.fr: Nous nous appelons après le dîner.
bank.en: We call each other after dinner.
bank.cue: Nous nous appelons means we call one another.

bank.fr: Mon amie suit un cours de danse.
bank.en: My friend takes a dance class.
bank.cue: Suivre un cours means take a course.

bank.fr: Je chante dans une chorale le jeudi.
bank.en: I sing in a choir on Thursdays.
bank.cue: Dans une chorale means in a choir.

bank.fr: Ils répètent avant le concert.
bank.en: They rehearse before the concert.

bank.fr: Le concert finit assez tard.
bank.en: The concert ends quite late.
bank.prompt: Hear how late the event finishes.

bank.fr: Je rentre en taxi après le spectacle.
bank.en: I go home by taxi after the show.

bank.fr: D'abord, je prépare le repas; ensuite, je mets la table.
bank.en: First I prepare the meal; next I set the table.

bank.fr: Le matin, puis-je travailler au calme ?
bank.en: Can I work quietly in the morning?
bank.prompt: Ask whether quiet morning work is possible.
bank.cue: Au calme means in a quiet setting.

bank.fr: Je peux choisir mes horaires.
bank.en: I can choose my hours.

bank.fr: Ma journée commence par une marche.
bank.en: My day begins with a walk.
bank.prompt: Identify the first activity of the day.
bank.cue: Commencer par introduces the first activity.

bank.fr: Elle prend une douche après le sport.
bank.en: She takes a shower after exercise.
bank.cue: Après le sport is the time phrase.

bank.fr: Nous nous habillons rapidement.
bank.en: We get dressed quickly.
bank.prompt: Translate the reflexive action and manner.

bank.fr: Je mange rarement au restaurant en semaine.
bank.en: I rarely eat at a restaurant during the week.
bank.prompt: Describe how often you dine out.
bank.cue: En semaine means during the week.

bank.fr: Le vendredi, j'aime retrouver mes amis.
bank.en: On Fridays, I like meeting my friends.
bank.prompt: Describe a preferred weekly social plan.
bank.cue: J'aime is followed by an infinitive.

bank.fr: Mon ami et moi faisons du bénévolat.
bank.en: My friend and I volunteer.

bank.fr: Je préfère les activités en plein air.
bank.en: I prefer outdoor activities.

bank.fr: Elle se repose un peu après le travail.
bank.en: She rests a little after work.
bank.prompt: Hear when she takes a rest.

bank.fr: Nous parlons français pendant le déjeuner.
bank.en: We speak French during lunch.
bank.prompt: Describe an opportunity to practise French.
bank.cue: Pendant le déjeuner sets the context.

bank.fr: Chaque soir, je note une nouvelle expression.
bank.en: Every evening, I write down a new expression.

activities.title: A weekday routine
activities.prompt: Listen to the whole message. Which activity happens before work?
activities.script: En général, je me lève à six heures et demie. Je prends un café, puis je marche jusqu'à l'arrêt. Je commence le travail à huit heures. Le soir, je prépare souvent le dîner avec ma sœur.
activities.explanation: The speaker says she walks to the stop before starting work.

activities.title: Weekend preferences
activities.prompt: Listen for the contrast between the two friends. What does Camille prefer?
activities.script: Le samedi, Hugo aime faire du sport tôt le matin. Camille préfère dormir un peu plus longtemps et retrouver ses amis pour un brunch. Ils vont parfois au marché après le repas.
options: Sleep later and meet friends for brunch
Shop at the market before breakfast
activities.explanation: Camille prefers sleeping longer and meeting friends for brunch; the market is an occasional later activity.

activities.title: Read a personal routine
activities.prompt: According to the post, when does the writer study French?
activities.passage: Ma semaine est bien remplie, mais j'étudie le français vingt minutes chaque soir. Le mardi, je révise avec une amie. Le dimanche, je regarde un film en français. Je préfère les courtes séances régulières aux longues séances rares.
activities.explanation: The writer says they study twenty minutes every evening.

activities.title: Follow a club schedule
activities.prompt: Read the schedule. Which activity is available on Thursday evening?
activities.passage: Club du quartier — Lundi : yoga, 18 h. Mercredi : cuisine, 19 h. Jeudi : chorale, 19 h 30. Samedi : promenade, 10 h. Inscription obligatoire pour l'atelier cuisine.
activities.explanation: The Thursday listing is chorale at 19:30.

activities.title: Describe a typical day
activities.prompt: Speak for 45 seconds about a typical weekday: say when you get up, two actions before or during work/study, what you like doing, and one thing you rarely do. Use at least two sequence or frequency words.
activities.model: En général, je me lève vers sept heures. D'abord, je prends le petit-déjeuner; ensuite, je vais au travail en bus. J'aime écouter un balado pendant le trajet. Le soir, je prépare le dîner et je lis un peu. Je regarde rarement la télévision.
rubric: The description has a clear sequence and at least three activities.
Frequency or time expressions make the routine specific.
A preference and a negative/rare habit are understandable.

activities.title: Write to a new classmate
activities.prompt: Write a 55–75-word message to a new classmate. Describe your usual weekday, name one activity you enjoy, and ask about their routine or preference.
activities.model: Salut Inès ! En semaine, je me lève vers six heures et demie. Je prends le métro et je commence le travail à huit heures. Après le travail, je fais souvent une promenade. J'aime cuisiner, mais je prépare rarement des plats compliqués. Et toi, qu'est-ce que tu aimes faire après les cours ? À bientôt !
rubric: The message describes a routine with present-tense verbs.
It includes a preference and a relevant follow-up question.
Connectors and frequency words make the ideas flow.
